instructor: Prof. Dr. Abdul Hadi Mohammed Adkhil
subject: 05_Soft_Computing

questions.question: A crisp relation is a subset of what?
questions.question_ar: العلاقة الحاسمة مجموعة جزئية من ماذا؟
options: the union of A and B
options_en: the union of A and B
questions.explanation: A crisp relation is a subset of the Cartesian product A times B.
questions.explanation_ar: العلاقة الحاسمة مجموعة جزئية من الجداء الديكارتي A في B.

questions.question: How many pairs does A times B contain?
questions.question_ar: كم زوجاً يحوي الجداء A في B؟
options: the larger of the two sizes
size of A times size of B
size of A plus size of B
size of A minus size of B
options_en: the larger of the two sizes
size of A times size of B
size of A plus size of B
size of A minus size of B
questions.explanation: The product holds the size of A multiplied by the size of B.
questions.explanation_ar: الجداء يحوي حجم A مضروباً في حجم B.

questions.question: What grades can a fuzzy relation entry take?
questions.question_ar: أي درجات يأخذها عنصر العلاقة الضبابية؟
options: any value from zero to one
only the values zero or one
options_en: any value from zero to one
only the values zero or one
questions.explanation: A fuzzy relation entry is any grade in the closed interval zero to one.
questions.explanation_ar: عنصر العلاقة الضبابية أي درجة في المجال من صفر إلى واحد.

questions.question: Building a relation from two fuzzy sets uses which operator?
questions.question_ar: بناء علاقة من مجموعتين ضبابيتين يستخدم أي عامل؟
options: one minus each of the grades
the sum of the two grades
options_en: one minus each of the grades
the sum of the two grades
questions.explanation: The relation from two sets takes the minimum of the two grades.
questions.explanation_ar: العلاقة من مجموعتين تأخذ أدنى الدرجتين.

questions.question: How do union and intersection work on fuzzy relations?
questions.question_ar: كيف يعمل الاتحاد والتقاطع على العلاقات الضبابية؟
options: cell by cell with max and min
row by row with simple sums
options_en: cell by cell with max and min
row by row with simple sums
questions.explanation: Union and intersection act cell by cell with max and min.
questions.explanation_ar: الاتحاد والتقاطع يعملان خلية بخية بالأقصى والأدنى.

questions.question: How is the max-min composition computed?
questions.explanation: For each cell, take the minimum of the pairs then the maximum of those minima.
questions.explanation_ar: لكل خلية، خذ أدنى الأزواج ثم أقصى تلك الأدنى.

questions.question: How does max-product compare with max-min?
questions.explanation: Because product never exceeds min, max-product never exceeds max-min.
questions.explanation_ar: لأن الضرب لا يتجاوز الأدنى، فالأقصى-ضرب لا يتجاوز الأقصى-الأدنى.

questions.question: Composition R then S requires what shared universe?
questions.question_ar: تركيب R ثم S يتطلب أي فضاء مشترك؟
questions.explanation: The middle universe Y is shared, like the inner matrix dimension.
questions.explanation_ar: الفضاء الأوسط Y مشترك، كالبعد الداخلي في ضرب المصفوفات.
